items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: That's where I met George Basserman, Hoagy Carmichael, Nat Jaffe...

ctx.x: Now, next to it, they built the Famous Door. It was a door in white. It looked like the entry to a Southern plantation -- the Famous Door. And the guy that was the host was Ran(?) somebody-or-the-other -- I forget his name. But eventually, they moved, and he went with them when they moved to California.
But getting back to it, focus on the Famous Door. Upstairs we had a pool table. That's where I met George Basserman, Hoagy Carmichael, Nat Jaffe... All the musicians
